distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, HP%, HP, SPD. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: CRIT DMG 10 (cap with a CRIT DMG body), CRIT Rate 12, HP% 2. SPD: 0 distributed even though SPD is in her list. 95 base + 14 (trace) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 138.63, already over 133.34. A 143 line (5 turns in 3 cycles needs 142.86) is 2 rolls away (143.23); GUESS not taken, because the team SPD ladder is Smitty's call. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
